lessons.title: The Report That Changed Everything
lessons.titleNative: El informe que lo cambió todo
lessons.context: A workplace story using compound tenses and formal register.

paragraphs.es: Para cuando el comité se reunió, el equipo ya había completado un análisis exhaustivo de la situación.
paragraphs.en: By the time the committee met, the team had already completed a thorough analysis of the situation.

paragraphs.es: La presentación de los resultados reveló una realidad que nadie había anticipado.
paragraphs.en: The presentation of the results revealed a reality no one had anticipated.

paragraphs.es: Habrían continuado con el plan original si el informe no hubiera expuesto los riesgos con tanta claridad.
paragraphs.en: They would have continued with the original plan if the report hadn't exposed the risks so clearly.

paragraphs.es: Gracias a esa investigación, la empresa habrá evitado pérdidas significativas para fin de año.
paragraphs.en: Thanks to that research, the company will have avoided significant losses by the end of the year.

paragraphs.es: La directora reconoció públicamente la importancia de la contribución del equipo.
paragraphs.en: The director publicly acknowledged the importance of the team's contribution.

questions.question: What had the team already done by the time the committee met?
What did the report reveal?
options: A reality no one had anticipated

questions.question: What would have happened without the report?
options: They would have changed course anyway
They would have continued with the original plan
The company would have grown faster

questions.question: What did the director do?

lessons.title: She Is Beautiful, She Looks Radiant
lessons.context: A story using nuanced ser vs estar.

paragraphs.es: Marina es una mujer decidida, pero hoy está especialmente nerviosa por la entrevista.
paragraphs.en: Marina is a determined woman, but today she's especially nervous about the interview.

paragraphs.es: Es lista, así que sabía exactamente cómo prepararse para cada pregunta difícil.
paragraphs.en: She's clever, so she knew exactly how to prepare for every difficult question.

paragraphs.es: Cuando llegó al edificio, ya estaba lista, con toda su documentación en orden.
paragraphs.en: When she arrived at the building, she was ready, with all her documentation in order.

paragraphs.es: Aunque normalmente es callada, esa mañana estuvo sorprendentemente conversadora con el entrevistador.
paragraphs.en: Although she's usually quiet, that morning she was surprisingly talkative with the interviewer.

paragraphs.es: Al final, salió de la entrevista sabiendo que había estado a la altura del reto.
paragraphs.en: In the end, she left the interview knowing she had risen to the challenge.

questions.question: How does Marina normally behave?
Why did she know how to prepare?
What was she like when she arrived?
How was she during the interview, compared to usual?

lessons.title: The Institution's Formal Statement
lessons.titleNative: El comunicado formal de la institución
lessons.context: A story built around formal register and nominalization.

paragraphs.es: La institución emitió un comunicado en el que se detallaba la implementación de las nuevas medidas.
paragraphs.en: The institution issued a statement detailing the implementation of the new measures.

paragraphs.es: Se enfatizó la importancia de la transparencia durante todo el proceso de transición.
paragraphs.en: The importance of transparency throughout the transition process was emphasized.

paragraphs.es: La aprobación de estas políticas requirió meses de deliberación entre los miembros del consejo.
paragraphs.en: The approval of these policies required months of deliberation among council members.

paragraphs.es: Se espera que, para el próximo trimestre, la institución haya completado la aplicación total de estas reformas.
paragraphs.en: It is expected that, by next quarter, the institution will have completed the full application of these reforms.

paragraphs.es: El comunicado concluyó agradeciendo la paciencia y colaboración de toda la comunidad.
paragraphs.en: The statement concluded by thanking the community's patience and collaboration.

questions.question: What did the statement detail?
What was emphasized?
What did the approval of the policies require?
How did the statement conclude?

lessons.title: By the Time We Realized
lessons.context: A story using future perfect and conditional perfect together.

paragraphs.es: Para cuando nos dimos cuenta del problema, ya habíamos invertido demasiado tiempo y dinero.
paragraphs.en: By the time we realized the problem, we had already invested too much time and money.

paragraphs.es: Si hubiéramos consultado a un experto antes, habríamos evitado varios errores costosos.
paragraphs.en: If we had consulted an expert earlier, we would have avoided several costly mistakes.

paragraphs.es: Sin embargo, dado que aprendimos de la experiencia, el próximo proyecto habrá sido mucho más eficiente.
paragraphs.en: However, since we learned from the experience, the next project will have been much more efficient.

paragraphs.es: A pesar de las dificultades, habríamos tomado la misma decisión de intentarlo, aunque con más cautela.
paragraphs.en: Despite the difficulties, we would have made the same decision to try it, though with more caution.

paragraphs.es: Para cuando termine el año, habremos recuperado la mayor parte de la inversión inicial.
paragraphs.en: By the end of the year, we will have recovered most of the initial investment.

questions.question: What had already happened by the time they realized the problem?
options: They had invested too much time and money

questions.question: What would consulting an expert earlier have done?
What will the next project have been, thanks to the lesson learned?
What do they expect by the end of the year?
options: Recovering most of the initial investment

lessons.title: The Diplomat's Dilemma
lessons.context: A story using formal register in a geopolitical context.

paragraphs.es: El diplomático sabía que cualquier declaración pública podría malinterpretarse fácilmente.
paragraphs.en: The diplomat knew that any public statement could easily be misinterpreted.

paragraphs.es: Dado que las negociaciones eran tan delicadas, cada palabra debía elegirse con extremo cuidado.
paragraphs.en: Given that the negotiations were so delicate, every word had to be chosen with extreme care.

paragraphs.es: Si hubiera hablado con más franqueza, es posible que las conversaciones se hubieran roto por completo.
paragraphs.en: If he had spoken more frankly, it's possible the talks would have broken down completely.

paragraphs.es: En cambio, optó por un lenguaje cuidadosamente ambiguo que dejaba espacio para el diálogo.
paragraphs.en: Instead, he chose carefully ambiguous language that left room for dialogue.

paragraphs.es: Para cuando concluyó la cumbre, ambas partes habrán logrado un acuerdo mínimo, pero significativo.
paragraphs.en: By the time the summit concluded, both parties will have achieved a minimal but significant agreement.

questions.question: Why was the diplomat careful with his words?
options: He didn't care about the outcome
Any statement could be easily misinterpreted
He didn't know the language well

questions.question: What might have happened if he had spoken more frankly?
options: The talks might have broken down completely

questions.question: What kind of language did he choose instead?
What did both parties achieve by the end of the summit?

lessons.title: The Startup Pitch
lessons.context: A business story combining finance vocabulary and formal register.

paragraphs.es: Los fundadores se presentaron ante los inversionistas con una propuesta cuidadosamente preparada.
paragraphs.en: The founders presented themselves to the investors with a carefully prepared proposal.

paragraphs.es: Explicaron que, para el próximo año, la empresa habrá triplicado sus ingresos si el plan se ejecuta correctamente.
paragraphs.en: They explained that, by next year, the company will have tripled its revenue if the plan is executed correctly.

paragraphs.es: Uno de los inversionistas, escéptico, preguntó qué habría pasado si el mercado hubiera cambiado repentinamente.
paragraphs.en: One of the investors, skeptical, asked what would have happened if the market had changed suddenly.

paragraphs.es: Los fundadores respondieron con datos concretos, demostrando que habían anticipado varios escenarios posibles.
paragraphs.en: The founders responded with concrete data, showing they had anticipated several possible scenarios.

paragraphs.es: Al final de la reunión, los inversionistas estaban convencidos de que valía la pena el riesgo.
paragraphs.en: By the end of the meeting, the investors were convinced the risk was worth it.

questions.question: How did the founders present themselves?
What did they claim would happen by next year?
options: The company will have tripled its revenue

questions.question: What did the skeptical investor ask about?
options: What would have happened if the market had changed

questions.question: How did the meeting end?
options: Investors were convinced the risk was worth it

lessons.title: A Village's Environmental Recovery
lessons.titleNative: La recuperación ambiental de un pueblo
lessons.context: A story using environmental vocabulary and compound tenses.

paragraphs.es: Hace una década, el río que atraviesa el pueblo estaba tan contaminado que casi no quedaba vida en él.
paragraphs.en: A decade ago, the river running through the town was so polluted that almost no life remained in it.

paragraphs.es: Si los habitantes no se hubieran organizado, la situación habría empeorado hasta volverse irreversible.
paragraphs.en: If the residents hadn't organized, the situation would have worsened until it became irreversible.

paragraphs.es: Gracias a años de esfuerzo colectivo, para hoy el río habrá recuperado gran parte de su biodiversidad original.
paragraphs.en: Thanks to years of collective effort, by today the river will have recovered much of its original biodiversity.

paragraphs.es: Los peces que alguna vez desaparecieron han vuelto a nadar en sus aguas.
paragraphs.en: The fish that once disappeared have returned to swim in its waters.

paragraphs.es: Este pueblo se ha convertido en un ejemplo de lo que la comunidad puede lograr cuando trabaja unida.
paragraphs.en: This town has become an example of what a community can achieve when it works together.

questions.question: How was the river a decade ago?
options: So polluted that almost no life remained

questions.question: What would have happened without the residents organizing?
options: The situation would have improved on its own
The situation would have become irreversible

questions.question: What has the river recovered?
What has the town become?

lessons.title: The Psychologist's Insight
lessons.context: A reflective story using psychology vocabulary and the subjunctive.

paragraphs.es: La psicóloga explicó que muchos de nuestros miedos provienen de experiencias que ni siquiera recordamos conscientemente.
paragraphs.en: The psychologist explained that many of our fears come from experiences we don't even consciously remember.

paragraphs.es: Sugirió que, en lugar de reprimir esas emociones, sería más útil que las examináramos con curiosidad.
paragraphs.en: She suggested that, instead of suppressing those emotions, it would be more useful for us to examine them with curiosity.

paragraphs.es: Si hubiéramos entendido esto antes, probablemente habríamos evitado años de ansiedad innecesaria.
paragraphs.en: If we had understood this before, we probably would have avoided years of unnecessary anxiety.

paragraphs.es: A pesar de que el proceso de autoconocimiento es incómodo, dado que trae grandes beneficios, vale la pena.
paragraphs.en: Although the process of self-knowledge is uncomfortable, given that it brings great benefits, it's worth it.

paragraphs.es: Salí de esa sesión sintiendo que, por primera vez, había entendido algo verdaderamente importante sobre mí mismo.
paragraphs.en: I left that session feeling that, for the first time, I had understood something truly important about myself.

questions.question: Where does the psychologist say many fears come from?
What did she suggest instead of suppressing emotions?
What would have been avoided if this had been understood earlier?
How did the writer feel leaving the session?
options: Like they had understood something important about themselves

lessons.title: The Historian's Warning
lessons.context: A story using historical/geopolitical vocabulary and connectors.

paragraphs.es: El historiador advirtió que, dado que la sociedad tiende a olvidar, los mismos errores suelen repetirse.
paragraphs.en: The historian warned that, since society tends to forget, the same mistakes tend to repeat.

paragraphs.es: Si los líderes de esa época hubieran prestado atención a las advertencias, la crisis se habría evitado.
paragraphs.en: If the leaders of that time had paid attention to the warnings, the crisis would have been avoided.

paragraphs.es: A pesar de las lecciones del pasado, muchas naciones siguen cometiendo errores similares.
paragraphs.en: Despite the lessons of the past, many nations continue making similar mistakes.

paragraphs.es: Sin embargo, ya que cada generación tiene la oportunidad de elegir un camino diferente, siempre existe esperanza.
paragraphs.en: However, since each generation has the opportunity to choose a different path, hope always exists.

paragraphs.es: Para cuando termine este siglo, habremos visto si la humanidad finalmente aprendió esta lección.
paragraphs.en: By the time this century ends, we will have seen whether humanity finally learned this lesson.

questions.question: What did the historian warn about?
options: That the same mistakes tend to repeat

questions.question: What would have happened if leaders had paid attention to warnings?
options: The crisis would have been avoided
The crisis would have been worse

questions.question: What does the historian say always exists?
What will we have seen by the end of the century?

lessons.title: A Final Reflection on Growth
lessons.titleNative: Una reflexión final sobre el crecimiento
lessons.context: A capstone reflective story reviewing B2+'s key grammar in context.

paragraphs.es: Cuando empecé este viaje, dudaba que llegara tan lejos, pero para cuando terminé, había superado todas mis expectativas.
paragraphs.en: When I started this journey, I doubted I would get this far, but by the time I finished, I had exceeded all my expectations.

paragraphs.es: Si hubiera sabido lo gratificante que sería, habría empezado mucho antes.
paragraphs.en: If I had known how rewarding it would be, I would have started much earlier.

paragraphs.es: A pesar de los momentos difíciles, dado que cada desafío me enseñó algo valioso, no cambiaría nada del proceso.
paragraphs.en: Despite the difficult moments, since every challenge taught me something valuable, I wouldn't change anything about the process.

paragraphs.es: Está claro que el aprendizaje nunca termina realmente, y eso, lejos de agotarme, me llena de energía.
paragraphs.en: It's clear that learning never really ends, and that, far from exhausting me, fills me with energy.

paragraphs.es: Para cuando llegues al final de tu propio camino, sé que habrás descubierto una versión de ti mismo mucho más fuerte.
paragraphs.en: By the time you reach the end of your own path, I know you will have discovered a much stronger version of yourself.

questions.question: What did the writer doubt at the start?
options: That the journey would be easy
That they would get this far

questions.question: What would the writer have done if they had known how rewarding it would be?
What did every challenge do?
What does the writer say about learning?
options: It never really ends, and that's energizing
